variants.name: sequence_join
variants.sql: SELECT m.sequence,m.created,m.body,c.id,c.name FROM conversation_search JOIN conversation_messages m ON m.sequence=conversation_search.rowid JOIN conversations c ON c.id=m.owner WHERE conversation_search MATCH 'project' AND m.owner='scale-pogo' ORDER BY bm25(conversation_search),m.sequence DESC LIMIT 20
variants.plan:
QUERY PLAN
|--SCAN conversation_search VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 0:M3
|--SEARCH m USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
|--SEARCH c USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_conversations_1 (id=?)
`--USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

variants.name: fts_filter_then_bodies
variants.sql: WITH matches AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT rowid,bm25(conversation_search) AS relevance FROM conversation_search WHERE conversation_search MATCH 'project' AND owner='scale-pogo' ORDER BY relevance,rowid DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT m.sequence,m.created,m.body,c.id,c.name FROM matches JOIN conversation_messages m ON m.sequence=matches.rowid JOIN conversations c ON c.id=m.owner ORDER BY matches.relevance,m.sequence DESC
